en.t: An allied army led by Philip II of Macedon overcame the forces of city-states led by Athens and Thebes at the Battle of Chaeronea, securing Macedonian hegemony over the majority of ancient Greece
en.s: The Battle of Chaeronea was fought in 338 BC, near the city of Chaeronea in Boeotia, between Macedonia under Philip II and an alliance of Greek city-states led by Athens and Thebes. The battle was the culmination of Philip's final campaigns in 339–338 BC and resulted in a decisive victory for the Macedonians and their allies.

zh.s: 公元前338年，马其顿军队与以雅典、底比斯为首的希腊城邦联军在维奥蒂亚的喀罗尼亚附近交战。马其顿国王腓力二世率军取胜；这场战役是他在公元前339至338年间最后一系列军事行动的高潮。

en.s: The Battle of Cannae (; Latin: [ˈkanːae̯]) was a key engagement of the Second Punic War between the Roman Republic and Carthage, fought on 2 August 216 BC near the ancient village of Cannae in Apulia, southeast Italy. The Carthaginians and their allies, led by Hannibal, surrounded and practically annihilated a larger Roman and Italian army under the consuls Lucius Aemilius Paullus and Gaius Terentius Varro.

zh.s: 坎尼会战（拉丁语：[ˈkanːae̯]）是第二次布匿战争中的一场关键战役，于公元前216年8月2日在意大利东南部阿普利亚地区古坎尼村附近爆发，交战双方是罗马共和国和迦太基。汉尼拔率领迦太基及其盟军包围了罗马执政官卢基乌斯·埃米利乌斯·保卢斯和盖乌斯·特伦提乌斯·瓦罗统率的规模更大的罗马及意大利军队，并几乎将其全歼。

en.t: Western Roman Emperor Majorian is arrested near Tortona (northern Italy) and deposed by the Suebian general Ricimer
en.s: The Roman emperor was the ruler of the Roman Empire, starting with the granting of the title augustus to Octavian in 27 BC. The title of imperator, originally a military honorific, was usually used alongside caesar, originally a cognomen. When a given Roman is described as becoming emperor in English, it generally reflects his accession as augustus, and later as basileus.

zh.t: 西罗马皇帝马约里安在托尔托纳附近被捕，随后被里西默废黜
zh.s: 罗马皇帝是罗马帝国的统治者，这一称号始于公元前27年屋大维获授“奥古斯都”。原为军事荣誉称号的“英白拉多”，通常与原为家族别名的“凯撒”一同使用。英语所说的某位罗马人成为皇帝，一般指他取得“奥古斯都”的地位；在后来的时期，则指取得“巴西琉斯”的地位。

en.s: The siege of Alexandria in 1174 was a short-lived and unsuccessful attempt by the Normans of Sicily to overthrow Saladin in Egypt.

zh.s: 1174年，西西里诺曼人试图在埃及推翻萨拉丁，但这场围城行动很快失败。

en.t: After the execution of her husband, Jeanne de Clisson sells her estates and raises a force of men with which to attack French shipping and ports
en.s: Jeanne de Clisson (1300–1359), also known as Jeanne de Belleville and the Lioness of Brittany, was a French–Breton noblewoman who became a privateer to avenge her husband after he was executed for treason by King Philip VI of France. She crossed the English Channel, targeted French ships, and regularly slaughtered almost their entire crew. It was her practice to leave at least one sailor alive to carry her message of vengeance.

zh.t: 丈夫被处决后，让娜·德·克利松变卖地产，招募人马袭击法国船只和港口
zh.s: 让娜·德·克利松（1300—1359年）又称让娜·德·贝尔维尔和“布列塔尼母狮”，是一位法国布列塔尼贵族女性。她的丈夫因叛国罪被法王腓力六世处决后，她成为私掠者为夫报仇。她穿越英吉利海峡，袭击法国船只，经常杀死船上几乎所有人，但通常至少留下一名水手，让他传达复仇的消息。

en.s: The Battle on Pyana River (Russian: Сражение на реке Пьяне) took place on August 2, 1377, on the Pyana River between the Golden Horde under Arab Shah (Arapsha) and an alliance of Russian principalities led by Prince Ivan Dmitriyevich, made up of the Pereyaslavl, Yaroslavl, Yuryev, Nizhny Novgorod, and Murom principalities. The Russian army, being drunken, was almost entirely routed by small forces of Arapsha, while Ivan Dmitriyevich had drowned together with druzhina and staff.

zh.s: 皮亚纳河战役（俄语：Сражение на реке Пьяне）发生于1377年8月2日，交战双方是阿拉伯沙（阿拉普沙）率领的金帐汗国与由伊万·德米特里耶维奇亲王率领的俄罗斯诸公国联军。联军包括佩列亚斯拉夫尔、雅罗斯拉夫尔、尤里耶夫、下诺夫哥罗德和穆罗姆公国。俄军因醉酒而几乎全军覆没，阿拉普沙以少量兵力将其击溃；伊万·德米特里耶维奇与其亲兵和随员一同溺亡。

en.t: Thomas Grey is executed for participating in the Southampton Plot
en.s: Sir Thomas Grey (30 November 1384 – 2 August 1415), of Heaton Castle in the parish of Norham, Northumberland, was one of the three conspirators in the failed Southampton Plot against King Henry V in 1415, for which he was executed.

zh.t: 托马斯·格雷因参与南安普敦阴谋而被处决
zh.s: 托马斯·格雷爵士（1384年11月30日—1415年8月2日）来自诺森伯兰郡诺勒姆教区的希顿城堡。他是1415年反对亨利五世国王的南安普敦阴谋案三名共谋者之一，因此被处决。

en.s: The Battle of Sokal was a battle between the army of the Grand Duchy of Lithuania and the Kingdom of Poland under the command of the Grand Hetman of the Lithuanian Prince Konstanty Ostrogski against the Crimean Khanate, which took place on August 2, 1519. The battle ended in victory for the Crimeans.

zh.s: 索卡尔战役于1519年8月2日爆发。交战双方是立陶宛大公国和波兰王国联军，以及克里米亚汗国。联军由立陶宛亲王、立陶宛大盖特曼康斯坦丁·奥斯特罗格斯基率领。战役以克里米亚军队获胜告终。

en.s: On 1 or 2 August 1537 (both dates are given in sources), near the Tuscan village of Montemurlo, the forces of the newly installed Duke Cosimo I of Florence defeated a hastily organized army of those who wished to overthrow the Medici and restore the Republic of Florence. Following the battle, Cosimo's bloody vengeance on all those who opposed Medici rule effectively ended organized opposition to his family in Florence. The victory led to the decision of Emperor Charles V to formally recognize Cosimo as Duke of Florence on 30 September 1537.

zh.s: 1537年8月1日或2日（两种日期均见于资料），新任佛罗伦萨公爵科西莫一世的军队在托斯卡纳的蒙特穆尔洛村附近，击败了一支仓促组建的军队。后者试图推翻美第奇家族，恢复佛罗伦萨共和国。战后，科西莫对反对美第奇统治者进行血腥报复，基本消除了佛罗伦萨境内有组织的反对势力。这场胜利促使皇帝查理五世于1537年9月30日正式承认科西莫为佛罗伦萨公爵。

en.s: The Battle of Marciano (also known as the Battle of Scannagallo) occurred in the countryside of Marciano della Chiana, near Arezzo, Tuscany, on August 2, 1554, during the Italian War of 1551. The battle marked the defeat of the Republic of Siena in its war against the Duchy of Florence, and resulted in Siena losing its independence and being absorbed into the Grand Duchy of Tuscany.

zh.s: 马尔恰诺战役也称斯坎纳加洛战役，于1554年8月2日在托斯卡纳阿雷佐附近的马尔恰诺德拉基亚纳乡间爆发，是1551年意大利战争的一部分。战役中，锡耶纳共和国在与佛罗伦萨公国的战争中战败，随后失去独立并被并入托斯卡纳大公国。

en.s: The Battle of Ērģeme (also Battle of Ermes) (Estonian: Härgmäe lahing; German: Schlacht bei Ermes; Russian: Битва под Эрмесом; Latvian: Ērģemes kauja) was fought on 2 August 1560 in present-day Latvia (near Valka) as part of the Livonian War between the forces of Ivan IV of Russia and the Livonian Confederation. It was the last battle fought by the German knights in Livonia and an important Russian victory.

zh.s: 埃尔格梅战役又称埃尔梅斯战役，于1560年8月2日在今拉脱维亚瓦尔卡附近爆发，是利沃尼亚战争的一部分。交战双方是俄国伊凡四世的军队与利沃尼亚邦联。这是德意志骑士在利沃尼亚进行的最后一场战斗，也是俄军的一次重要胜利。

en.t: Peñón de Vélez de la Gomera expedition (1563)
en.s: In 1563, a Spanish military expedition was launched to reconquer the exclave of Peñón de Vélez de la Gomera, which was under the control of the Ottomans. The campaign ended in a fiasco for the Spanish troops.

zh.s: 1563年，西班牙军队发动远征，试图从奥斯曼人手中夺回佩尼翁-德韦莱斯-德拉戈梅拉飞地，最终以惨败告终。

en.s: The Battle of Molodi (Russian: Би́тва при Мóлодях) was one of the key battles of Ivan the Terrible's reign. It was fought near the village of Molodi, circa 50 km (31 mi) south of Moscow, in July–August 1572 between the 120,000 horde of Devlet I Giray of Crimea and about 60,000–70,000 Russians and Cossacks led by Prince Mikhail Vorotynsky.

zh.s: 莫洛季战役（俄语：Би́тва при Мóлодях）是伊凡雷帝统治期间的关键战役之一。战役于1572年7月至8月在莫斯科以南约50公里（31英里）的莫洛季村附近进行。德夫莱特一世·格莱伊率领约12万克里米亚军队，迎战由米哈伊尔·沃罗滕斯基亲王率领的约6万至7万俄军和哥萨克。

en.s: The siege of Lier of 1582, also known as the capture of Lier or betrayal of Lier, took place between 1 and 2 August 1582 at Lier, near Antwerp (present-day in the Belgian province of Antwerp, Flemish Region, Belgium), during the Eighty Years' War.

zh.s: 1582年利尔围城战又称利尔陷落或利尔背叛，发生于1582年8月1日至2日的八十年战争期间。利尔位于安特卫普附近，即今比利时弗拉芒大区安特卫普省。

en.s: The Conquest of the Azores (also known as the Spanish conquest of the Azores), but principally involving the conquest of the island of Terceira, occurred on 2 August 1583, in the Portuguese archipelago of the Azores, between forces loyal to the claimant D.

zh.s: 征服亚速尔群岛，又称西班牙征服亚速尔群岛，主要针对特尔塞拉岛，于1583年8月2日在葡萄牙的亚速尔群岛发生。交战部队中有一方效忠于王位争夺者D.。

en.s: The siege of Rheinberg, also known as the Rhine campaign of 1601, was the siege of the towns of Rheinberg (Old Dutch: Rijnberk) and Meurs from 12 June to 2 August 1601 during the Eighty Years' War and the Anglo–Spanish War. Maurice of Orange with an Anglo-Dutch army besieged the Spanish-held cities in part to distract them before their impending siege at Ostend.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 莱茵贝格围城战也称1601年莱茵战役，于1601年6月12日至8月2日在八十年战争和英西战争期间进行。奥兰治的莫里斯率领英荷联军围攻西班牙控制的莱茵贝格（古荷兰语：Rijnberk）和默尔斯两座城镇，部分目的是转移西班牙方面的注意力，为即将对奥斯坦德的围城战作准备。

en.s: The Capture of La Mámora was a successful Spanish raid, commanded by Admiral Luis Fajardo y Chacón, on the town of La Mamora, south of El Araich in August 1614 as part of a campaign against African privateering at the Moroccan coast. The fortress remained part of the Spanish Kingdom until 1681 when Muley Ismail Ibn Sharif, the Sultan of Morocco took the city from the Spaniards.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1614年8月，路易斯·法哈多·查孔海军上将率西班牙军队突袭摩洛哥海岸阿尔阿赖什以南的拉马莫拉镇，这是打击非洲海盗行动的一部分。西班牙一直控制着当地要塞，直到1681年摩洛哥苏丹穆莱·伊斯梅尔·伊本·谢里夫将其夺回。

en.s: The Battle of Rathmines, 2 August 1649, took place outside Dublin, in the suburb of Rathmines. Part of the Irish Confederate Wars and 1639 to 1653 Wars of the Three Kingdoms, it has been described as the 'decisive battle of the Engagement in Ireland.' In late July 1649, a combined Irish Confederate/Royalist army under the Earl of Ormond, tried to capture Dublin.

zh.s: 拉斯迈恩斯战役发生于1649年8月2日，地点在都柏林郊外的拉斯迈恩斯。战役是爱尔兰邦联战争和1639至1653年三国之战的一部分，被称为“爱尔兰战事中的决定性战役”。1649年7月下旬，奥蒙德伯爵率领爱尔兰邦联军和保王党联军试图攻占都柏林。

en.s: The siege of Dublin took place in 1649 during the Irish Confederate Wars. It was a failed attempt by combined Irish Royalist and Confederate forces to capture the capital of Dublin which was held by English Republican forces under Michael Jones. It was part of a strategy by Duke of Ormonde, head of an alliance loyal to Charles II, to seize the remaining foothold of Ireland still under the control of the London Parliament.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 爱尔兰同盟战争期间，爱尔兰保王派和邦联军队试图夺取都柏林，但未能攻下；都柏林由迈克尔·琼斯率领的英国共和军控制。奥蒙德公爵为忠于查理二世的同盟者制定了夺取爱尔兰议会军最后据点的计划，这次围城正是计划的一部分。

en.s: The battle of Aa (Swedish: Slaget vid Aa; Russian: Битва на Аа) occurred on 2 August 1656 during the early stages of the Russo-Swedish War of 1656–1658. Swedish forces under command Generalmajor Streiff faced 1,200–3,500 Russian troops under stolnik Semyon Izmailov. It is impossible to establish how the battle ended, because the attitudes of both sides contradict each other.

zh.s: 阿河战役（瑞典语：Slaget vid Aa；俄语：Битва на Аа）发生于1656年8月2日，是1656至1658年俄瑞战争初期的一场战斗。斯特赖夫少将率领的瑞典军队与斯托利尼克谢苗·伊兹迈洛夫指挥的1,200至3,500名俄军交战。由于双方对战斗结果的说法相互矛盾，无法确定战斗以何种结果告终。

en.s: The Battle of Vågen was a naval battle between a Dutch merchant and treasure fleet and an English flotilla of warships on 2 August 1665 as part of the Second Anglo-Dutch War. The battle took place in Vågen (meaning "the bay, voe" in Norwegian), the main port area of neutral Bergen, Norway.

zh.s: 沃根湾海战是第二次英荷战争期间的一场海战，于1665年8月2日在挪威卑尔根的沃根湾爆发。交战双方是荷兰商船和宝船舰队与英国舰队。沃根湾（挪威语意为“海湾”）是卑尔根的主要港区，当时卑尔根保持中立。

en.t: Henry Morgan's raid on Porto Bello
en.s: Henry Morgan's raid on Porto Bello was a military event which took place in the latter half of the Anglo-Spanish war beginning on 10 July 1668. Welsh buccaneer Henry Morgan led a largely English privateer force against the heavily fortified Spanish controlled town of Porto Bello (now Portobelo in modern Panama). After landing, Morgan and his men attempted to take the castles protecting the town.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.t: 亨利·摩根袭击波多贝洛
zh.s: 威尔士海盗亨利·摩根率领一支以英国私掠船员为主的队伍，袭击当时由西班牙控制的坚固城镇波多贝洛（今巴拿马的波托韦洛）。登陆后，摩根和部下试图攻下守城堡垒。这次袭击发生在英西战争后半段；该战争始于1668年7月10日。

en.s: The Battle of Karlowitz was the first military engagement between the Ottomans and the Austrians within the Austro-Turkish War (1716–1718). The battle ended with an Ottoman victory that resulted in the rout of an Austrian reconnaissance force.

zh.s: 卡尔洛维茨战役是奥土战争（1716—1718年）中奥斯曼帝国与奥地利军队的首次交战。战斗以奥斯曼军获胜告终，奥地利一支侦察部队被击溃。

en.t: Signing of the United States Declaration of Independence
en.s: The signing of the United States Declaration of Independence occurred following its July 4,1776 approval by 56 delegates to the Second Continental Congress meeting in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. The declaration proclaimed that the thirteen American colonies then at war with Great Britain were now sovereign states, and thus no longer a part of the British Empire. Although the wording of the Declaration was approved by Congress on July 4, the date of its signing has been disputed. Most historians have concluded that it was signed nearly a month after its adoption, on August 2, 1776, and not on July 4 as is commonly believed.

zh.s: 《美国独立宣言》由56名代表于1776年7月4日在费城举行的第二届大陆会议上批准，签署发生在批准之后。宣言宣布，正在与英国交战的13个美洲殖民地成为主权国家，不再属于大英帝国。宣言文本虽于7月4日获国会批准，但签署日期一直存在争议。多数历史学家认为，宣言是在通过近一个月后签署，即1776年8月2日，而非通常所认为的7月4日。

en.s: The Battle of Tromsø (also known as the Battle of Pølsehavna) was fought on 2 August 1812 between the British and Dano-Norwegian navies as part of the Gunboat War. HMS Horatio, a 38-gun British frigate under the command of Captain Lord George Stuart, was fired at by the 4-gun Dano-Norwegian cutter No. 97 which fled to Tromsø after discovering the ship's true identity.

zh.s: 特罗姆瑟海战又称波尔瑟哈夫纳战役，于1812年8月2日爆发，是炮艇战争的一部分，交战双方为英国和丹麦-挪威海军。英国38炮护卫舰“贺拉斯号”由乔治·斯图尔特勋爵上校指挥，遭到丹麦-挪威97号四炮快艇射击。该快艇认出对方真实身份后，逃往特罗姆瑟。

en.s: The Battle of the Pyrenees was a large-scale offensive (the author David Chandler recognises the 'battle' as an offensive) launched on 25 July 1813 by Marshal Jean-de-Dieu Soult from the Pyrénées region on Emperor Napoleon's order, in the hope of relieving French garrisons under siege at Pamplona and San Sebastián. zh.s: 马拉坎德围城战于1897年7月26日至8月2日进行，围攻对象是英属印度西北边境省马拉坎德地区的英国驻军。英军面对普什图部落武装。这些部落的土地被杜兰线一分为二；杜兰线全长1,519英里（2,445公里），是在英阿战争结束时划定的阿富汗与英属印度边界。英国划定边界，是为了遏制其所担忧的俄罗斯帝国向印度次大陆扩张影响力。
zh.n: 英阿战争：增援纵队抵达马拉坎德各邦的英国驻军后，围城结束。

Due to the defensive nature of the battle, the event draws parallels with the Battle of Rorke's Drift during the Anglo-Zulu War.

en.s: The 1900 North Carolina gubernatorial election was held on August 2, 1900. Democratic nominee Charles Brantley Aycock defeated Republican nominee Spencer B. Adams with 59.57% of the vote. The election started a string of 18 consecutive elections in which the Democratic nominee won the Governor's office. The state would not elect another Republican as governor until James E. Holshouser, Jr. won in 1972.

en.t: German occupation of Luxembourg during World War I
en.s: From 2 August 1914 until the end of World War I on 11 November 1918, the Grand Duchy of Luxembourg was under full occupation by the German Empire. The German government justified the occupation by citing the need to support their armies in neighbouring France, although many Luxembourgers, past and present, have interpreted German actions otherwise.

zh.t: 第一次世界大战期间德国占领卢森堡
zh.s: 1914年8月2日至1918年11月11日第一次世界大战结束，卢森堡大公国一直处于德意志帝国的全面占领之下。德国政府以需要支援驻扎在邻国法国的军队为由，为占领行动辩护；但许多卢森堡人，无论过去还是现在，对德国的行动都有不同解读。

en.s: The Western Front was one of the main theatres of war during World War I. Following the outbreak of war in August 1914, the German Army opened the Western Front by invading Luxembourg and Belgium, then gaining military control of important industrial regions in France. The German advance was halted in the Battle of the Marne.

en.s: The Battle of Pilckem Ridge (31 July – 2 August 1917) was the opening attack of the Third Battle of Ypres in the First World War. The British Fifth Army, supported by the Second Army on the southern flank and the French 1reArmée (First Army) on the northern flank, attacked the German 4th Army, which defended the Western Front from Lille northwards to the Ypres Salient in Belgium and on to the North Sea coast.

en.s: The 1918 Vancouver general strike was a general strike that took place in response to the death of Albert "Ginger" Goodwin on 2 August 1918. It was the first general strike in the history of British Columbia and a pivotal event in the Canadian Labour Revolt, which would unfold over the following years.

zh.s: 1918年温哥华总罢工是为回应阿尔伯特·“金杰”·古德温于1918年8月2日去世而发起的一次总罢工。这是英属哥伦比亚历史上的首次总罢工，也是加拿大劳工起义中的关键事件；这场劳工运动在随后几年继续发展。

en.s: The Holywell ambush was an ambush on the Ballyhaunis to Claremorris road near Holywell in the early hours of Monday, 2 August 1920 carried out by the Irish Republican Army (IRA) during the Irish War of Independence. Approximately 20 local IRA volunteers commanded by Patrick Kenny attacked a British Military detachment that was guarding a broken down petrol lorry.

zh.s: 霍利韦尔伏击战发生于1920年8月2日（星期一）凌晨，地点在霍利韦尔附近、巴利豪尼斯至克莱尔莫里斯公路上，是爱尔兰独立战争期间爱尔兰共和军实施的一次伏击。帕特里克·肯尼率领约20名当地共和军志愿兵，袭击了一支负责看守一辆抛锚汽油货车的英国军方分队。

en.s: The Vlora War (Albanian: Lufta e Vlorës or Lufta e Njëzetës) or Vlora crisis (Italian: Crisi di Valona) was a military conflict in the Vlorë region of Albania between the Kingdom of Italy and Albanian nationalists. en.s: The 1st National Congress of the Chinese Communist Party was held in Shanghai and Jiaxing between July 23 and August 2, 1921. The congress established the Chinese Communist Party (CCP).

en.t: U.S. Vice President Calvin Coolidge becomes president upon the death of President Warren G. Harding
en.s: Calvin Coolidge (born John Calvin Coolidge Jr.; KOOL-ij; July 4, 1872 – January 5, 1933) was the 30th president of the United States, serving from 1923 to 1929. A Republican lawyer from Massachusetts, he served from 1921 to 1923 as the 29th vice president, under President Warren G. Harding, and from 1919 to 1921 as the 48th governor of Massachusetts.

zh.t: 哈定总统逝世，副总统卡尔文·柯立芝继任美国总统
zh.s: 卡尔文·柯立芝原名小约翰·卡尔文·柯立芝，生于1872年7月4日，卒于1933年1月5日，是美国第30任总统，任期为1923年至1929年。他来自马萨诸塞州，是共和党律师，曾于1919年至1921年担任该州第48任州长，随后于1921年至1923年在沃伦·G.哈定任内担任第29任副总统。

en.s: Adolf Hitler (20 April 1889 – 30 April 1945) was an Austrian-born German politician who was dictator of Germany in the Nazi era from 1933 until his suicide in 1945. He rose to power as the leader of the Nazi Party, becoming the chancellor of Germany in 1933 and then taking the title of Führer und Reichskanzler in 1934.

zh.t: 希特勒掌握国家元首权力
zh.s: 阿道夫·希特勒（1889年4月20日—1945年4月30日）出生于奥地利，是德国政治人物。他从1933年起统治纳粹德国，直至1945年自杀。希特勒以纳粹党领袖身份崛起，于1933年出任德国总理，1934年又取得“元首兼帝国总理”的头衔。

en.s: The Marihuana Tax Act of 1937, Pub. L. 75–238, 50 Stat. 551, enacted August 2, 1937, was a United States act that placed a tax on the sale of cannabis. It was the first national regulation on cannabis in the US. The H.R. 6385 act was drafted by Harry Anslinger and introduced by Rep. Robert L. Doughton of North Carolina, on April 14, 1937.

en.s: The Treblinka uprising, also known as the Treblinka revolt, was a rebellion and mass escape of prisoners that took place on 2 August 1943 at the German Nazi Treblinka extermination camp. The uprising was organized by members of the camp's underground resistance, which had formed in the early months of 1943. Its goal was to destroy the extermination center and enable a mass escape of the prisoners.

zh.s: 特雷布林卡起义又称特雷布林卡反抗，是一场囚犯叛乱和集体逃亡事件，于1943年8月2日在纳粹德国的特雷布林卡灭绝营爆发。起义由营内地下抵抗组织成员策划，该组织于1943年初成立。起义目标是摧毁灭绝中心并帮助大批囚犯逃脱。

en.s: The Battle of Boernerowo, also known as the Boernerowo massacre, was a clash between a Home Army company led by Lieutenant Jerzy Terczyński, codenamed Starża, and a subunit of the German 1st Fallschirm-Panzer Division Hermann Göring. The battle occurred on the morning of 2 August 1944 near the suburban settlement of Boernerowo outside Warsaw, resulting in the destruction of the Polish unit and the death of most of its soldiers.

zh.s: 博尔内罗沃战役又称博尔内罗沃屠杀，交战双方是由耶日·特尔琴斯基中尉（代号“斯塔尔扎”）率领的本土军连队和德国“赫尔曼·戈林”第1伞兵装甲师的一支分队。战斗于1944年8月2日上午在华沙郊外的博尔内罗沃定居点附近爆发，波兰部队被歼灭，大多数士兵阵亡。

en.t: Insurgent attacks on the Bielany airfield
en.s: The insurgent attacks on the Bielany airfield were an unsuccessful attempt by the Home Army soldiers to capture the Bielany airfield in Warsaw during the early days of the Warsaw Uprising in 1944. In the insurgents' plans, capturing the Bielany airfield was highly prioritized. The task was assigned to soldiers from the VIII Region Łęgi of the Warsaw County Subdistrict, supported by part of the forces from the Żoliborz Subdistrict.

en.t: 1947 BSAA Avro Lancastrian Star Dust accident
en.s: On 2 August 1947, Star Dust, a British South American Airways (BSAA) Avro Lancastrian airliner on a flight from Buenos Aires, Argentina, to Santiago, Chile, crashed into Mount Tupungato in the Argentine Andes. An extensive search operation failed to locate the wreckage, despite covering the area of the crash site. The fate of the aircraft and its occupants remained unknown for over fifty years, giving rise to various conspiracy theories about its disappearance.

zh.t: 1947年BSAA“星尘号”阿芙罗·兰开斯特客机事故
zh.s: 1947年8月2日，英国南美航空公司（BSAA）一架名为“星尘号”的阿芙罗·兰开斯特客机从阿根廷布宜诺斯艾利斯飞往智利圣地亚哥途中，撞上阿根廷安第斯山脉的图蓬加托山。尽管搜寻行动覆盖了坠机区域附近的大范围地区，仍未能找到残骸。飞机及乘客的下落五十多年间一直不明，引发了各种失踪阴谋论。

en.s: The Battle of the Notch was an engagement between United States and North Korean forces early in the Korean War on August 2, 1950 in southern South Korea. The fight ended in a victory for the United States after North Korean forces attempting to assault the US position were blocked and repelled repeatedly, suffering heavy casualties. Reeling from the Hadong Ambush and being driven from the city of Chinju, the US Army's 19th Infantry Regiment, 24th Infantry Division scrambled to protect the pass into Masan, the final South Korean city before the Naktong River, where the UN was holding its Pusan Perimeter in place.

zh.s: 山口战役于1950年8月2日朝鲜战争初期在韩国南部爆发，交战双方是美国和朝鲜军队。朝鲜军队多次试图攻打美军阵地，均被挡回并遭受重大伤亡，最终美军获胜。美军第24步兵师第19步兵团刚从河东伏击战中撤出，又被迫离开晋州，仓促赶往马山一带守住关口。这是南洛东江之前的最后一座韩国城市，联合国军正在那里维持釜山防御圈。

en.s: Casiguran [ˌkaːsɪˈguːɾan], officially the Municipality of Casiguran (Tagalog/Kasiguranin: Bayan ng Casiguran; Ilocano: Ili ti Casiguran), is a municipality in the province of Aurora, Philippines. According to folk legend, the name Casiguran was obtained from the Ilocano term Sigod which means "edge" or "maximum", which is due to the location of the municipality at the northern edge of Aurora Province.

zh.s: 卡西古兰是菲律宾奥罗拉省的一个自治市。根据2024年人口普查，当地有26855名居民，安姆罗河保护景观区也位于其境内。民间传说认为，卡西古兰一名源自伊洛卡诺语Sigod，意思是“边缘”或“尽头”，与该市位于奥罗拉省北端的位置有关。

en.s: The 1969 FA Charity Shield was the 47th FA Charity Shield, an annual football match played between the winners of the previous season's Football League and FA Cup competitions. en.s: The Bologna massacre (Italian: strage di Bologna) was a terrorist bombing of the Central Station at Bologna, Italy, on the morning of 2 August 1980, which killed 85 people and wounded more than 200. The attack was carried by the neo-fascist terrorist organization Nuclei Armati Rivoluzionari (Armed Revolutionary Nuclei), which always denied any involvement; other theories have been proposed, especially in correlation with the strategy of tension. The bombing is the fourth deadliest terrorist attack in Western Europe behind the Nice attack in 2016, Paris attacks in November 2015, and the Madrid train bombings in 2004.

zh.s: 博洛尼亚大屠杀（意大利语：strage di Bologna）是一起恐怖爆炸袭击。1980年8月2日上午，炸弹在意大利博洛尼亚中央车站爆炸，造成85人死亡、200多人受伤。新法西斯恐怖组织“武装革命核心”实施了袭击，但该组织始终否认参与。另有其他说法，尤其是将袭击与“紧张战略”联系起来的理论。按死亡人数计算，这起爆炸案是西欧第四严重的恐怖袭击，仅次于2016年尼斯袭击、2015年11月巴黎袭击和2004年马德里列车爆炸案。

en.s: The 1989 Valvettiturai massacre occurred on 2 and 3 August 1989 in the small coastal town of Valvettiturai, on the Jaffna Peninsula in Sri Lanka. Sixty-four Sri Lankan Tamil civilians were killed by soldiers of the Indian Peace Keeping Force. The massacre followed an attack on the soldiers by rebel Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam cadres. en.s: The Iraqi invasion of Kuwait, codenamed Project 17, began on 2 August 1990 and marked the beginning of the Gulf War. After defeating the State of Kuwait on 4 August 1990, Iraq went on to militarily occupy the country for the next seven months. The invasion was condemned internationally, and the United Nations Security Council (UNSC) adopted numerous resolutions urging Iraq to withdraw from Kuwaiti territory. The Iraqi military, however, continued to occupy Kuwait and defied all orders by the UNSC.

en.s: Space Shuttle Atlantis (Orbiter Vehicle designation: OV‑104) is a retired Space Shuttle orbiter vehicle which belongs to NASA, the spaceflight and space exploration agency of the United States. en.s: Presidential elections were held in Croatia for the first time on 2 August 1992 alongside simultaneous parliamentary elections. The result was a victory for incumbent Franjo Tuđman of the Croatian Democratic Union (HDZ), who received 57.8% of the vote, becoming the first popularly elected president of Croatia. Voter turnout was 74.9%. The 1,519,000 votes received by Tuđman remains the highest number of votes won by any president to date. Having previously been selected as president by Parliament, he was sworn in for his first proper term as president on 12 August 1992 at Saint Mark's square in Zagreb.

zh.s: 克罗地亚于1992年8月2日首次举行总统选举，同时举行议会选举。克罗地亚民主共同体候选人、时任总统弗拉尼奥·图季曼以57.8%的得票率获胜，成为克罗地亚首位民选总统，投票率为74.9%。图季曼获得1,519,000张选票，至今仍是该国总统选举中得票最多的候选人。他此前由议会选为总统，并于1992年8月12日在萨格勒布圣马尔谷广场宣誓就任首个正式任期。

en.s: The Second Congo War, also known as Africa's World War or the Great War of Africa, was a major conflict that began on 2 August 1998 in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), just over a year after the First Congo War. en.s: Air France Flight 358 was a regularly scheduled international flight from Charles de Gaulle Airport in Paris, France, to Toronto Pearson International Airport in Ontario, Canada. en.s: The 2007 Nashville mayoral election took place on September 11, 2007, following a primary election on August 2, 2007. Incumbent Mayor Dayne Walling, who was first elected in the 2009 special election, ran for re-election to a full term. en.s: A by-election was held for the ʻEua Noble seat to the Legislative Assembly of Tonga on 2 August 2012. It was triggered by the dismissal from Parliament of the incumbent, the Speaker Lord Lasike, following his conviction for illegal possession of ammunition in July. The Tongan nobility elect nine representatives to Parliament. Technically, ʻEua is not a distinct constituency. Seventeen nobles jointly elect the three representatives of Tongatapu and the single representative of ʻEua, from within the same pool of nobles.

For this annual event the "Comisión de Box y Lucha Libre Mexico D.F." (Mexico City Boxing and Wrestling Commission) allowed wrestlers who had previously been unmasked after losing a Luchas de Apuestas, or bet match, to wear their masks again.

zh.s: 2014年昆山爆炸事故（中文：2014年昆山中荣工厂爆炸事故；拼音：2014 Nián Kūnshān Zhōngróng Gōngchǎng Bàozhà Shìgù）是一起粉尘爆炸事故，于2014年8月2日发生在中国江苏省昆山市的中荣金属制品公司一家汽车零部件工厂。截至2014年12月30日，爆炸造成146名工人死亡、114人受伤。

en.s: The 2015 Johan Cruyff Shield was the twentieth edition of the Johan Cruyff Shield (Dutch: Johan Cruijff Schaal), an annual Dutch football match played between the winners of the previous season's Eredivisie and KNVB Cup. The match was contested by Arsenal, the 2014–15 FA Cup winners, and Chelsea, champions of the 2014–15 Premier League. It was held at Wembley Stadium on 2 August 2015.

en.s: The 2018 Knox County mayoral election was held on August 2, 2018, to determine the mayor of Knox County, Tennessee.
